adjudication.rationale: `group_member.hbs` uses `{{#unless automatic}}...{{/unless}}`, but the new `group-member` view (`app/assets/javascripts/admin/views/group-member.js.es6`) does not define/bind an `automatic` property. In `group.hbs` the members are rendered via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`, so inside the item view/template `automatic` is not clearly coming from the group/controller context. If it resolves to `undefined` in the item template context, `unless automatic` will evaluate truthy and show the remove link even for automatic groups (which the backend now rejects via `can_not_modify_automatic`). This is a concrete, diff-grounded UI behavior defect/fragility introduced by the new itemView template.
